articles.title: Swift rolls out new blockchain ledger to bring 24/7 banking to 17 global giants
articles.snippet: HSBC, UBS, Wells Fargo and Citi are among the 17 banks now preparing to pilot live transactions using tokenized digital assets on Swift’s new blockchain payments platform.

articles.title: Hong Kong regulator orders new anti-phishing measures for crypto platforms
articles.snippet: Hong Kong’s regulator has ordered crypto platforms and online brokers to meet newly issued phishing-resistant login requirements within the next 12 months.

articles.title: Interpol operation exposes $122M crypto wallet tied to romance scam laundering
articles.snippet: Interpol said a suspect's crypto wallet processed over $122.5 million in 10 months as authorities uncovered the scheme during a global anti-fraud operation that led to 5,811 arrests.

articles.title: Mark Cuban-backed DeFi dashboard Zapper shutters after 7 years
articles.snippet: Zapper provided crypto market data to over 2 million monthly active users and oversaw more than $13 billion in processed transactions during its peak.

articles.title: Tokenized stock transfers surge 105% in a month to $8.4B
articles.snippet: Industry data shows trading activity and market value accelerating as crypto companies and traditional financial institutions expand tokenized equity initiatives.
